notes.title: Ruarua.ru 2.2 Update~
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637337/522e5bf7d3b40378cfca1c34bb0036efe9037bc8.png"]

Ruarua.ru Version 2.2 is now live — Explorers, come and take a look!

A new region, Heaven, has arrived — you’ll need mysterious methods to enter and explore it.

New cards, Potato Mirror Halo, is now available.

New mobs, Dove, S***** , will appear in the zone mode.

Mechanics Update: Ultimate Mob Adjustment — As more high-level explorers emerge, to make exploration easier for everyone, Zone-mode Ultimate mobs will now remain attackable for 10 minutes after reaching near-death, allowing players to continue dealing damage for loot. The total damage requirement has been adjusted from 3% to 5%.
